description: Na₃SrTiNb₃O₁₂ crystallizes in the monoclinic P2/c space group. There are three inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded in a 10-coordinate geometry to ten O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.55-2.91 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a 10-coordinate geometry to ten O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.57-2.91 Å. In the third Na site, Na is bonded in a 10-coordinate geometry to ten O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.59-2.87 Å. Sr is bonded to twelve O atoms to form distorted SrO₁₂ cuboctahedra that share faces with two equivalent TiO₆ octahedra and faces with six NbO₆ octahedra. There are a spread of Sr-O bond distances ranging from 2.62-3.12 Å. Ti is bonded to six O atoms to form TiO₆ octahedra that share corners with six NbO₆ octahedra and faces with two equivalent SrO₁₂ cuboctahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 6-13°. There are four shorter (1.98 Å) and two longer (2.00 Å) Ti-O bond lengths. There are three inequivalent Nb sites. In the first Nb site, Nb is bonded to six O atoms to form NbO₆ octahedra that share corners with two equivalent NbO₆ octahedra, corners with four equivalent TiO₆ octahedra, and faces with two equivalent SrO₁₂ cuboctahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 6-13°. There are two shorter (2.00 Å) and four longer (2.01 Å) Nb-O bond lengths. In the second Nb site, Nb is bonded to six O atoms to form NbO₆ octahedra that share corners with six NbO₆ octahedra and faces with two equivalent SrO₁₂ cuboctahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 6-22°. There are four shorter (2.00 Å) and two longer (2.01 Å) Nb-O bond lengths. In the third Nb site, Nb is bonded to six O atoms to form NbO₆ octahedra that share corners with two equivalent TiO₆ octahedra, corners with four equivalent NbO₆ octahedra, and faces with two equivalent SrO₁₂ cuboctahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 6-22°. There are two shorter (2.01 Å) and four longer (2.02 Å) Nb-O bond lengths. There are six inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to three Na, one Sr, one Ti, and one Nb atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Sr, and two Nb atoms. In the third O site, O is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to three Na, one Sr, one Ti, and one Nb atom. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a 2-coordinate geometry to two Na, one Sr, and two Nb atoms. In the fifth O site, O is bonded in a distorted linear geometry to three Na, one Sr, and two Nb atoms. In the sixth O site, O is bonded in a distorted linear geometry to three Na, one Sr, one Ti, and one Nb atom.
